mapper.sql: FROM ent_enterprise_change c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.changed_by LEFT JOIN data_source_record r ON r.id = c.source_record_id LEFT JOIN data_source s ON s.id = r.source_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ent_enterprise_change c WHERE c.enterprise_id = #{enterprise}
mapper.sql: FROM data_import_batch b LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = b.created_by JOIN data_source s ON s.id = b.source_id
mapper.select:
SELECT b.id, b.file_name, b.total_count, b.success_count, b.fail_count, b.status, b.created_at, b.finished_at, u.username AS created_by_username, s.source_name
ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id FROM data_import_batch WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.external_id AS `row_number`, r.enterprise_id, r.parse_status, r.parse_error, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.raw_payload, '$.name')) AS enterprise_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.raw_payload, '$.uscc')) AS uscc, r.created_at FROM data_source_record r
ORDER BY CAST(r.external_id AS UNSIGNED), r.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
